caseName: Aurelius Capital Management, L.P. v. Tribune Media Co.
caseNameFull: AURELIUS CAPITAL MANAGEMENT, L.P. v. TRIBUNE MEDIA COMPANY, fka Tribune Company, fka Times Mirror Corporation

opinions.text: Motion of Bankruptcy Law Professors for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Former Federal Judges for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.
